details.title: First Haul
details.message: Step one: get a Basic Tow Rig. Use `view_market` to check the exchange, or pick up a Dusthound from the shipyard — it comes with one pre-fitted. Step two: use `install_mod` to equip it. Step three: use `get_wrecks` to find wrecks at your location, `tow_wreck` to attach one, and haul it back here. Your speed drops while towing, so plan your route.
